name: Claude Agent SDK
description: Anthropic's SDK for building agents on the Claude Code harness.
descriptionZh: Anthropic 的 SDK，用于在 Claude Code 运行时之上构建 Agent。
license: MIT (SDK); Claude Code CLI under Anthropic commercial terms
keyFact: The Claude Agent SDK was renamed from the Claude Code SDK on 29 September 2025 and ships for Python and TypeScript under MIT for the SDK code itself; the underlying Claude Code CLI remains governed by Anthropic's commercial terms.
keyFactZh: Claude Agent SDK 于 2025 年 9 月 29 日由 Claude Code SDK 更名而来，提供 Python 与 TypeScript 版本，SDK 代码本身为 MIT 许可；其底层的 Claude Code CLI 仍受 Anthropic 商业条款约束。
